poses.caption: Lie on your back with feet close together on the bench and arms beside you
Press through the heels and lift hips until shoulders, hips and knees align

jobs.detail: NARROW LEG BENCH GLUTE BRIDGE, TWO phases, side three-quarter view. Body head on IMAGE LEFT, feet on SAME stable low flat padded bench on IMAGE RIGHT. Bench fixed rectangular gray pad, legs and whole base fit in each panel. Floor mat under upper body. BOTH heels/soles rest ON TOP bench, feet CLOSE TOGETHER touching or 2cm gap, knees bend and track together, no wide stance. Hands flat beside hips arms straight on floor, palms DOWN. LEFT: lie supine, back of skull and shoulder blades directly resting on mat, eyes up, neck neutral, pelvis lowered to floor, knees bent, heels remain close together atop bench. RIGHT: drive through heels and lift PELVIS until shoulders-hips-knees make straight diagonal, head/shoulder blades/arms stay floor, no lumbar overextension. Both feet remain close on bench, knees remain bent; bench and camera unchanged. Only glutes soft red tint through intact opaque black shorts over side/rear hips, no hamstrings/quadriceps/abs red. Exposed limbs detailed fine grayscale muscle fibers.
